explanation: I is false: the singular values are |a| and |a|, both nonnegative. II is true because a 5×2 matrix has at most 2 distinct singular values, which implies at most 5. III is true because A^T A is 5×5 and therefore has at most 5 distinct eigenvalues and singular values. Thus “II and III only” is required but absent from the choices. The previous feedback incorrectly treated a tighter upper bound as disproving a looser one; it does not justify selecting “III only” here.
